# --- WHO WE ARE ---
Kunstwerkstube Baden is a contemporary art gallery and art café located at
Bäderstrasse 28, 5400 Baden, Switzerland, in the historic spa quarter (Bäderquartier),
approximately 100 metres from Spa 47. The gallery occupies a historic building called
"Haus zu den Drei Eidgenossen". Owner and curator: Kseniia Chudina (Kseniia Chudina Art + Event).

# --- WHAT WE DO ---
- Curated contemporary art exhibitions (solo and group)
- Art café: a meeting place for art lovers in Baden
- Support for emerging and established artists
- Vernissages, art workshops, artist talks and cultural events
- Artist residency and exhibition rental for independent artists

# --- EXHIBITION FORMATS FOR ARTISTS ---
Artists can rent the gallery for solo exhibitions in three formats:
  - 1 week:  CHF 1,800
  - 2 weeks: CHF 2,900
  - 3 weeks: CHF 3,900
Consultations are free. Applications via appointment at:
https://calendar.app.google/TNL2uckUNbEuzeev9

# --- CURRENT & UPCOMING ---
- mainArt Künstler in Baden: 11–21 June 2026 (gallery open Mon–Fri 11–19, Sat 10–19, Sun 10–18)
- ART BRUT exhibition: 19 April – 28 June 2026, Waldgasthaus Baldegg
- Solo Barbara Pichierri-Maag: 2 February – 31 May 2026, Waldgasthaus Baldegg
Outside exhibition periods, gallery visits are by appointment only.
